source_text.body:
Have Operator complete online training modules
An instructor used Operator to complete ladder safety compliance training and an astronomy course module as a dummy student; it was slow, struggled with simulations and was blocked on YouTube.
·
Nov 14, 2026
Done with
OP
Operator
What they did
Andrew VandenHeuvel pointed Operator at his online astronomy course, logged in as a dummy student, and had it do one unit. The unit had a discussion, a lab and a quiz, and Operator also posted an ice-breaker. He reminded it to add a photo. He graded each piece himself and took over the browser once to test YouTube.
How it went
Operator scored 31/50. It did well on the ice-breaker and the quiz (14/15). It failed the simulation discussion, left the lab mostly blank, couldn't take screenshots, and couldn't play YouTube videos.
Worth knowing
Operator needed a $200 month of OpenAI Pro and worked slowly, so he limited it to a single module.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Log in to [course site] with the test account I give you and work through the module titled [module name], watching or reading each section and answering the quiz questions. Tell me if you get stuck on a simulation or a video that will not load, and finish with a summary of what was completed and the score. Pause and ask me before submitting any final assessment or certification.
Original source: https://andrewvh.substack.com/p/dear-operator-see-me-after-class
